# Fairy Finds Boutique

> Artisanal women's fashion house and bespoke couture atelier located in Neendoor, Kottayam, Kerala, India. We craft ready-to-wear sarees, lehengas, kurtis, and bespoke bridal wear with express worldwide and all-India delivery.

## Atelier Details

- **Business Name:** Fairy Finds Boutique
- **Location:** Neendoor, Kottayam, Kerala 686601, India
- **WhatsApp / Phone:** +91 6282629144
- **Email:** hello@fairyfindsboutique.com
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/fairyfinds.boutique
- **Website:** https://fairyfindsboutique.store
- **Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/): Explore featured collections, artisanal designs, and customer reviews.
- [Shop Catalog](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/shop): Browse our ready-to-wear designer dresses, sarees, and tops.
- [Custom Made Couture](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/custom): Bespoke bridal tailoring, hand-embroidery, and WhatsApp consultations.
- [Our Story](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/about): Heritage, artisanal craftsmanship, and background of our Kottayam atelier.
- [Contact & Location](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/contact): Atelier address in Neendoor, Kottayam, phone number, and directions.

## Product Categories

- [Sarees](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/category/sarees): Pure silk, organza, and festive ready-to-wear sarees.
- [Dresses](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/category/dresses): Contemporary ethnic and western silhouettes.
- [Tops & Blouses](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/category/blouses): Handcrafted blouses and structured tops.
- [Other Fashion](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/category/other): Curated celebratory ensembles and accessories.

## Collections

- [Red Saree](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/collections/red-saree): Crimson silk drapes with gold zari accents.
- [Green Lehenga](https://fairyfindsboutique.store/collections/green-lehenga): Micro-velvet celebratory festive silhouettes.

## Ordering Process

Customers can browse ready-to-wear pieces directly on our storefront or initiate custom bridal tailoring commissions through WhatsApp. Direct WhatsApp ordering provides 1-on-1 sizing consultations, personalized fabric selection, and international doorstep shipping updates.
